summary: Fire Station Service PPM + Engineer calibration matrix — FRONTEND E2E verified. (1) Service Desk /service-desk → Maintenance → Create PM: service-type dropdown (data-testid=ppm-create-service) lists 'Fire Station Service (PM + treadmill calibration)'. (2) Engineer job /svc/engineer/jobs/FSDEMO-case-1 → COMPLETE tab: CalibrationCapture (data-testid=calibration-capture) auto-renders. Treadmill count chip reads '2 treadmills'. Exactly two treadmill blocks are shown — calibration-treadmill-0 = 'Technogym Run 1000' (SN TG-A-001) and calibration-treadmill-1 = 'Life Fitness T5' (SN LF-B-002); calibration-treadmill-2 is absent (bike correctly excluded). Each block exposes 8 labelled inputs (3/6/9/12 mph and 0/5/10/15% incline). Filled all 8 readings on tm0, set tm1 result select to 'fail', clicked Save → POST /api/svc/engineer/jobs/FSDEMO-case-1/calibration returned 200; overall status chip in the panel flipped to FAIL. Clicked Download certificate → GET .../certificate returned 200 with content-type application/pdf.

issues: Calibration panel is only visible under the COMPLETE tab, not auto-opened on page load as the review request implied ('auto-opened' happens after clicking COMPLETE). The panel itself is auto-expanded (open=true) once the tab is entered, so behaviour matches spec, but a first-time visitor sees SUMMARY by default; consider surfacing a 'Calibration required' hint from Summary.

critical_code_review_comments: EngineerJobDetailV2.js is 4330 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. CalibrationCapture (from line 4123) should be split into its own module for maintainability.

Calibration panel lives inside the COMPLETE tab only; if PM/Fire Station users are expected to enter readings before completion, consider also surfacing it under EQUIPMENT or as a top-level card when service_type requires calibration.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (has is_service_desk=true, org iso-demo-org). Pre-seeded case: FSDEMO-case-1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The engineer calibration panel is under the COMPLETE tab (not visible on SUMMARY). Click the tab labelled 'Complete' (uppercase display via CSS, actual text 'Complete'). Then wait for data-testid=calibration-capture. Panel opens by default. Inputs: calibration-tm-{i}-reading-{0..7} (0-3 = 3/6/9/12 mph, 4-7 = 0/5/10/15% incline). Result select per treadmill: calibration-treadmill-result-{i} with values 'pass'/'fail'. Save button: calibration-save (POST /api/svc/engineer/jobs/{case}/calibration). Download: calibration-download-cert (GET certificate, application/pdf).
